const question = $json.question || "";
const q = question.toLowerCase();

const isPurchaseOrderQuestion =
  q.includes("purchase") ||
  q.includes("purchasing") ||
  q.includes("po") ||
  q.includes("order") ||
  q.includes("closed") ||
  q.includes("open") ||
  q.includes("status");

const isInventoryQuestion =
  q.includes("inventory") ||
  q.includes("stock") ||
  q.includes("storage");

let query;
let params = {};

if (isPurchaseOrderQuestion) {
  let status = null;
  if (q.includes("closed")) status = "CLOSED";
  if (q.includes("open")) status = "OPEN";

  params = { status };

  query = `
MATCH (po:PurchaseOrder)
WHERE $status IS NULL OR toUpper(toString(po.status)) = $status
OPTIONAL MATCH (po)-[:ORDERED_FROM]->(vendor:Actor)
OPTIONAL MATCH (po)-[:ORDERS_MATERIAL]->(material:Material)
RETURN
  po.po_number AS po_number,
  coalesce(vendor.actor_id, po.vendor_id) AS vendor_id,
  coalesce(vendor.actor_name, vendor.display_name, vendor.name, po.vendor_id) AS vendor_name,
  po.material_id AS material_id,
  coalesce(material.material_name, material.display_name, po.material_description) AS material_description,
  po.quantity AS quantity,
  po.uom AS uom,
  po.unit_price_eur AS unit_price_eur,
  po.currency AS currency,
  po.total_value_eur AS total_value_eur,
  po.status AS status,
  po.po_date AS po_date,
  po.requested_delivery_date AS requested_delivery_date,
  po.goods_receipt_date AS goods_receipt_date,
  po.is_master_record AS is_master_record
ORDER BY po.po_number
LIMIT 200
`;
} else if (isInventoryQuestion) {
  query = `
MATCH (inv:InventorySnapshot)
OPTIONAL MATCH (inv)-[:SNAPSHOT_OF_MATERIAL]->(material:Material)
OPTIONAL MATCH (inv)-[:PRIMARY_VENDOR]->(vendor:Actor)
RETURN
  inv.material_id AS material_id,
  coalesce(material.material_name, inv.material_description) AS material_description,
  inv.storage_location AS storage_location,
  inv.stock_qty AS stock_qty,
  inv.uom AS uom,
  inv.total_stock_value_eur AS total_stock_value_eur,
  inv.stock_status AS stock_status,
  inv.snapshot_date AS snapshot_date,
  coalesce(vendor.actor_id, inv.primary_vendor) AS primary_vendor
ORDER BY inv.material_id, inv.storage_location
LIMIT 200
`;
} else {
  query = `
MATCH (a:Actor)
WHERE
  coalesce(a.is_master_record, false) = true
  OR toLower(coalesce(a.actor_role, "")) IN ["supplier", "manufacturer", "vendor"]
  OR EXISTS { MATCH (a)-[:SUPPLIES]-() }
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r]-(connected)
RETURN
  coalesce(a.actor_id, a.id) AS supplier_id,
  coalesce(a.actor_name, a.display_name, a.name) AS supplier_name,
  a.region AS region,
  a.actor_role AS actor_role,
  labels(connected) AS connected_labels,
  coalesce(
    connected.display_name,
    connected.actor_name,
    connected.material_name,
    connected.material_id,
    connected.unit_id,
    connected.id
  ) AS connected_entity,
  type(r) AS relationship,
  properties(connected) AS connected_properties
ORDER BY supplier_id
LIMIT 100
`;
}

return [
  {
    json: {
      agent: "procurement_specialist",
      domain: "Procurement Specialist",
      question,
      query,
      params,
    },
  },
];
